# Kaomoji

> kaomoji.fyi is a fast, installable kaomoji picker: search Japanese emoticons (text faces such as ¯\_(ツ)_/¯ and ʕ•ᴥ•ʔ), emoticons, emoji and symbols by feeling, then tap to copy and paste anywhere.

Every page is static HTML, and the picker installs as a Progressive Web App that works offline. There are no accounts and no tracking cookies; favourites and recents stay in the visitor's browser. The code is open source under the GNU AGPL-3.0.

## Main pages

- [Kaomoji picker](https://kaomoji.fyi/): the home page, with search and one-tap copy across every category
- [What is a kaomoji?](https://kaomoji.fyi/guide/): a guide to Japanese text faces, how they differ from emoji and emoticons, how they are built and where they came from
- [Kaomoji maker](https://kaomoji.fyi/maker/): build a custom kaomoji by choosing each part
- [All tags](https://kaomoji.fyi/tags/): an index of every tag page
- [Get the app](https://kaomoji.fyi/download/): how to install the picker on a phone or desktop

## Popular tags

- [Shrug](https://kaomoji.fyi/t/shrug/): the shrug face and its variants
- [Lenny face](https://kaomoji.fyi/t/lenny-face/): ( ͡° ͜ʖ ͡°) and its variants
- [Table flip](https://kaomoji.fyi/t/table-flip/): (╯°□°)╯︵ ┻━┻ and other table flips
- [Look of disapproval](https://kaomoji.fyi/t/look-of-disapproval/): ಠ_ಠ and other disapproving stares
- [Bear](https://kaomoji.fyi/t/bear/): bear faces such as ʕ•ᴥ•ʔ
- [Cat](https://kaomoji.fyi/t/cat/): cat faces
- [Hug](https://kaomoji.fyi/t/hug/): hugging kaomoji
- [Heart](https://kaomoji.fyi/t/heart/): kaomoji with hearts
- [Sparkles](https://kaomoji.fyi/t/sparkles/): sparkly kaomoji
- [Cry](https://kaomoji.fyi/t/cry/): crying faces
- [Dogeza](https://kaomoji.fyi/t/dogeza/): the deep bow of apology
- [Owo](https://kaomoji.fyi/t/owo/): owo faces
